parameters.query:
select r.litellm_model, r.temperature, r.max_tokens, r.nudge,
       r.price_in_usd_per_1k, r.price_out_usd_per_1k, r.fallback_price_per_unit, r.impact,
       p.resolution
from model_routing r
left join image_gen_params p on p.impact = r.impact
where r.impact in ($1, '__default__') and r.modality = $2 and r.active = true
order by (r.impact = $1) desc
limit 1;

nodes.name: Parse Response
nodes.notes: ADR-047 Block B: reads the text seam (Call Model Text). out0 item = seam contract {fell_back, model_used, body, headers} (primary or one-tier-below fallback). out1 routes to Retry Text-Only (Opus text-only); that item carries statusCode, used to distinguish the branch. fell_back replaces fell_back_to_opus (renamed). image_unprocessable set only when images were present on the Retry branch.

nodes.name: Call Log Model Run
nodes.notes: ADR-035: the shared agent_runs writer also owns cost math (FX, PLN, token-price fallback). Returns cost_pln_total + cost_missing.

nodes.name: Routing Missing?
nodes.notes: 0-row routing guard: true when Lookup Routing matched nothing and Resolve Routing fell back to its safety-net model (routing_row_missing). True -> CRITICAL alert. Both branches reconverge to Check Degradation so Shape Output stays the sole leaf (sub-workflow return determinism).

nodes.name: Alert Routing Missing
nodes.notes: CRITICAL via Post Alert (v1): the model_routing table has no row for this impact/modality/PD combo. The run still replies via Resolve Routing's safety-net model, so this is loud-but-non-blocking. Reconverges to Check Degradation (not a leaf).

nodes.name: Retry Text-Only
nodes.notes: Block 6 (ADR-036): final safety net. Reached only when BOTH the routed model AND the Opus fallback failed AND images were present (a corrupt/1x1/unprocessable image 4xxs every image-bearing call). Retries text-only on Opus with images stripped + a [BRAK] marker (messages_text_only from Resolve Routing) -> Parse Response sets image_unprocessable -> WARN multimodal/image-unprocessable. No onError here: if THIS also fails it throws -> Execute LLM Call CRITICAL, so a genuine non-image failure is NOT masked.

nodes.name: Image Unprocessable?
nodes.notes: Block 6: true when the routed model could not consume the input image and the run degraded to a text-only retry. True -> WARN multimodal/image-unprocessable. Both branches reconverge into Call Log Model Run so Shape Output stays the sole branch-free leaf (sub-workflow return determinism), mirroring Routing Missing? -> Check Degradation.

nodes.name: Alert Image Unprocessable
nodes.notes: Block 6 WARN via Post Alert (v1): a corrupt/non-vision input image was dropped and the answer was produced text-only. Loud-but-non-blocking; reconverges to Call Log Model Run (not a leaf).

nodes.name: Normalize Model Result
nodes.notes: Block 9: single convergence of the text + image branches into one uniform schema. Keeps Shape Output the sole branch-free leaf (return determinism).

parameters.jsCode:
// ADR-051 Block 5: text + multimodal-INPUT only (image-gen branch deleted; Generate Images Parallel (v1)
// owns image OUTPUT). Reads Parse Response and emits the uniform schema for Log Model Run + the
// degradation chain + Shape Output. Keeps Shape Output the sole branch-free leaf (return determinism).
const t = ($('Parse Response').first() ? $('Parse Response').first().json : {}) || {};
let rrm = false;
try { rrm = !!$('Resolve Routing').first().json.routing_row_missing; } catch (e) {}

return [{ json: {
  output_modality: 'text',
  success: true,
  completion: t.completion || '',
  output_blocks_json: t.output_blocks_json || '[]',
  delivered_via_tool: !!t.delivered_via_tool,
  b64_json: null,
  mime: null,
  size: null,
  size_overridden: false,
  resolution_note: '',
  image_degraded: false,
  cost_header_missing: false,
  model_used: t.model_used,
  provider: t.provider,
  input_tokens: (t.input_tokens != null) ? t.input_tokens : null,
  output_tokens: (t.output_tokens != null) ? t.output_tokens : null,
  usd_cost: (t.usd_cost != null) ? t.usd_cost : null,
  price_in_usd_per_1k: t.price_in_usd_per_1k,
  price_out_usd_per_1k: t.price_out_usd_per_1k,
  impact: t.impact,
  task_type: t.task_type || '',
  clickup_task_id: t.clickup_task_id || '',
  triggered_by: t.triggered_by || 'explicit_command',
  invocation_type: t.invocation_type || 'explicit',
  caller_user_id: t.caller_user_id || '',
  process_type: t.process_type || '',
  routing_default_used: !!t.routing_default_used,
  routing_row_missing: !!(t.routing_row_missing || rrm),
  fell_back: !!t.fell_back,
  image_unprocessable: !!t.image_unprocessable,
  images_dropped: t.images_dropped || 0
} }];

nodes.name: Resolve Lower Tier Text
nodes.notes: ADR-047 Block B: resolve the one-tier-below TEXT model for the fallback seam (ResolveLowerTier, GNO6ZsIcSpvYUJDq). Returns {floor:true} at Niski -> empty litellm_model -> seam re-sends primary -> both-down -> Retry Text-Only Opus safety net keeps the text floor degrading rather than CRITICALing.

nodes.name: Call Model Text
nodes.notes: ADR-047 Block B: text path via the shared fallback seam (Call Model with Fallback v1) on /v1/chat/completions. Primary = routed model; fallback = one-tier-below text model. success_path empty (2xx+body; text tiers are all Claude, no empty-content risk). onError=continueErrorOutput: out0 -> Parse Response (primary OR one-tier fallback served); out1 (both-down throw) -> Retry Text-Only (Opus text-only safety net, ADR-036 Block 6). Replaces the old Call LiteLLM + Fallback to Opus; ADR-037 Opus fallback is now the top-tier case of one-tier-below (Krytycznie/Fable -> Opus).
